info.name: Shopify Admin REST About Webhooks API
Webhooks
Shopify Retrieve a list of webhooks

params.name: topic
params.description: Filter by webhook topic

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results (max 250, default 50)

params.name: since_id
params.description: Return webhooks after the specified ID

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include

items.docs: Retrieves a list of webhook subscriptions for the app.

info.name: Shopify Create a webhook subscription

items.docs: Creates a new webhook subscription. When the specified event occurs Shopify sends an HTTP POST to the provided address.

info.name: Shopify Retrieve a count of webhooks

params.name: topic
params.description: Count webhooks for a specific topic

items.docs: Retrieves a count of existing webhook subscriptions.

info.name: Shopify Retrieve a single webhook

params.name: webhook_id
params.description: The ID of the webhook

items.docs: Retrieves a single webhook subscription by ID.

info.name: Shopify Update a webhook subscription

params.name: webhook_id
params.description: The ID of the webhook

info.name: Shopify Delete a webhook subscription

params.name: webhook_id
params.description: The ID of the webhook

info.name: Shopify Retrieves A List Of Webhooks

params.name: address
params.description: Retrieve webhook subscriptions that send the POST request to this URI.

params.name: created_at_max
params.description: Retrieve webhook subscriptions that were created before a given date and time (format: 2014-04-25T16:15:47-04:00).

params.name: created_at_min
params.description: Retrieve webhook subscriptions that were created after a given date and time (format: 2014-04-25T16:15:47-04:00).

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of the properties you want returned for each item in the result list. Use this parameter to restrict the returned list of items to only those properties you specify.

params.name: limit
params.description:
Maximum number of webhook subscriptions that should be returned. Setting this parameter outside the maximum range will return an error.
                  (default: 50, maximum: 250)

params.name: since_id
params.description: Restrict the returned list to webhook subscriptions whose id is greater than the specified since_id.

params.name: topic
params.description:
Show webhook subscriptions with a given topic.
For a list of valid values, refer to the topic property.>

params.name: updated_at_min
params.description: Retrieve webhooks that were updated before a given date and time (format: 2014-04-25T16:15:47-04:00).

params.name: updated_at_max
params.description: Retrieve webhooks that were updated after a given date and time (format: 2014-04-25T16:15:47-04:00).

info.name: Shopify Create A New Webhook Subscription By Specifying Both An Address And A Topic

params.name: format
params.description:
Use this parameter to select the data format for the payload. Valid values are json and xml.
                  (default: json)
